name: 92014 · Del Mar, CA
findings: ZIP 92014 (Del Mar) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92014 (Del Mar) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92014 (Del Mar) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
